name: Culprit Finder
description: Diagnostic-only frame pacing investigator. Captures detailed frame spikes, PlayerObject input timing, rolling frame-time history, iOS memory snapshots, thermal state, and evidence-based possible causes. Does not alter gameplay, rendering settings, caching, or prediction.

enabled.name: Enable Capture
enabled.description: Enable frame-time and player-input diagnostics. Does not change gameplay.

spike-threshold-ms.name: Frame Spike Threshold (ms)
spike-threshold-ms.description: Capture a frame when its start-to-start gap reaches this threshold. 20 ms is a useful starting point for a 60 Hz device.

show-overlay.name: Show Last Spike Overlay
show-overlay.description: Show a compact six-second in-level summary after a detected spike. The full report is written to the Geode log.

platform-snapshot.name: Capture iOS Memory and Thermal State
platform-snapshot.description: Sample resident/virtual memory, device physical memory, processor count, and iOS thermal state only when a detailed report is captured.

frame-timeline.name: Include Recent Frame Timeline
frame-timeline.description: Include the ten most recent frame gaps, drawScene timings, and engine deltas in detailed spike reports.

report-cooldown-ms.name: Detailed Log Cooldown (ms)
report-cooldown-ms.description: Avoid flooding the log during a continuous hitch burst. Every spike still updates counters and the overlay; coalesced events are counted.
